market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to mildly lower over next 1-3 months. RBA rate decision and IMF fiscal warning create headwinds. Banks and gold provide support; iron ore and consumer names drag. Volatility elevated. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a tight band with upside capped by rate fears.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. 2027 recession probability rising but not yet base case. Anthropic datacentre capex and gold exploration provide structural positives. Energy transition policy reversals add uncertainty. A soft landing remains possible if global demand holds, but consumer squeeze is intensifying.
